doc.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Financing the club and Wayne as the main man
summary: He leaves the loan negotiations to Wayne, who took over around the Grand Avenue years.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: So definitely a capital improvement here. What - you know - now we’re coming
into, I assume, this entailed loans and everything else to be able to...
And having to convey to a bank that we’re opening up a jazz club. Was that ­ and we need finances to do that - was that difficult?
I don’t know, Wayne handled that, so I don’t know. He’s the main man now.
When did Wayne take over the business? At what point?
I think when we were on Grand Avenue; I think that’s when it was.
